$comment: Resolved content baselines for the federated entries in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json.
Deliberately NOT stored in marketplace.json: that file is consumed by Claude Code
against its own marketplace schema, and must not carry keys the plugin loader does
not expect. This sidecar is read only by scripts/check-federated-content.mjs.
Why it exists: a federated entry pins a tag by NAME, and a tag name is mutable.
Re-pointing it at different content is silent - every consumer follows, and the
existing pin check still passes because it only asks whether the tag resolves and
declares the matching version. lore-cli and quest-cli both had v0.6.0 deleted and
recreated on 2026-09-10/11 (OMARK-43); the skill content happened to be unchanged,
but nothing in CI could have told us if it had not been.
To update: re-resolve the chain yourself (tag ref -> tag object -> commit -> root
tree -> skills subtree), confirm the content is what you intend to ship, and record
the new SHA here in the same change that moves the pin. Updating this file is the
act of saying 'I verified this content', so do not update it to make CI go green.
Release handshake, agreed with the lore-cli session and tracked there as LCLI-469:
lore-cli messages this repository at tag-cut time with the tag name, the tag object
SHA, the commit it peels to, and the resolved skills/ tree SHA, so a new release
arrives with its baseline rather than as a red check here. The same is expected of
quest-cli. Do not take those SHAs on trust - they are a head start, not a
verification; re-resolve them here before recording, which is the whole point of
this file. If a pin bump ever lands without its baseline moving, the checker fails
on purpose rather than silently checking the wrong tag.

opum-lore.note: OMARK-48. v0.6.2 was tagged before it was npm-published; the pin was deliberately held at v0.6.1 until dist-tags.latest actually moved (see this repo's persistent memory, opum-lore-pin-held-at-v0.6.1.md), to avoid pointing the skill at a CLI release nobody could install yet. Publish confirmed independently: npm dist-tags.latest is 0.6.2, npm view version is 0.6.2. Tag chain (commit ea3813ae39fd9c9bba1e5e24e32a4c73e1611480 -> root tree 9881f02e -> skills subtree 24277e9a...) resolved independently via the GitHub API in an earlier verification pass, not copied from lore-cli's message; byte-identical to the v0.6.0/v0.6.1 baseline, so this move changes zero content under skills/. plugin.json at the tag self-declares version 0.6.2. Per LCLI-482 (still open): 0.6.2 carries no OIDC/SLSA provenance, same as 0.6.1 -- an npm-side fact, not a git tag chain fact, so it does not affect this entry. lore-cli's own warning stands for whatever tag comes next: LCLI-480 landed on lore-cli main after this tag was cut, moving skills/ there to 2998f74d077845f8ad73f83aa296e37e034378a4 -- do not reuse 24277e9a past v0.6.2; re-resolve for real at the next tag cut.

opum-quest.note: Re-verified after the quest-cli history reset (OMARK-43); skills subtree byte-identical to the pre-deletion baseline.
